label: adult-s3
resisted: Nothing resisted coverage. Closed-form error 0.57 logit is 3-s.f. rounding in the capital-gain penalty at extreme gains (logit ~-100, output saturated); other leaves <=0.026. Dead/redundant nodes: 4607 never active; Scotland gate masked by its saturating direct edge; 12550/15301 linear and near-inert. Age effect flat above the mean. Category names and USD kinks inferred.
tool_bugs: Composition subgraph_nodes must contain only its own nodes (child exits in entry_nodes). KernelSHAP (200) ~9 min; noise on unconnected inputs.
summary: P(income<=50K) = sigmoid(2.095 + linear backbone + capital-gain penalty + youth hinge + categorical offsets), additive. Backbone a sparse logistic regression (education-num, married-civ-spouse, husband, wife, male, hours, capital-loss; Without-pay switch). Capital-gain chain is a concave piecewise-linear penalty with kinks ~3.9k and 4.9k USD (ablation AUC 0.913 -> 0.891). Age adds up to +2.15 logit only below the mean. Nine small one-hot gates add per-category offsets. Train acc 0.858, AUC 0.913.
